senses.gloss: m. (יבל) vessel made of willow twigs; basket, or perforated trough; (as to shape v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Călathus).
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 43b">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00617"><he>בִּילוֹן</he></cite> a. <cite ref="K00541"><he>כִּילוֹן</he></cite>. Sab. 123ᵇ; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 92a:2">Snh. 92ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>א׳ דקצרי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אוכ׳</he>) the fuller’s trough. Ib. 28ᵇ the father of the husband and the father of the wife are no more kinsmen <he>אלא כי א׳ לדנא</he> (ed. <he>אכלא</he>) than is a basket related to a barrel. [For <he>אכלא</he>, <cite ref="A00529"><he>אוכלא</he></cite> cmp. <he>כְּלִיל</he>, <cite ref="K00757"><he>כַּלְכָּלָה</he></cite>.]
